description: A pocket groovebox for the Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Pocket groovebox: synths, mic sampler, drums, patterns and songs
store.description: ZSynth turns the Cardputer Zero into a groovebox. Four tracks (lead synth, bass synth, sampler and drums) play eight patterns per song, each 1-32 steps in any time signature, chained into a song. Play notes live and record them into the loop, or write them step by step on a drum grid and a piano roll. Design sounds on the Sound screen and keep them in an instrument library that plays each one as you browse. Record samples with the built-in mic, or use the 18 starter samples (FM piano, marimba, kalimba, sax, gong and more, from the CC0 Versilian Community Sample Library). Comes with a demo song, night-shift.
